title: glechoma micrantha
intro: Glechoma micrantha, commonly known as Creeping Lemon Balm or Ground Ivy, is a perennial, creeping plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma micrantha include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Glechoma micrantha include rosmarinic acid, caffeic acid, and ursolic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
